sloka: हिरण्यं वा सुवर्णं वा रत्नानि विविधानि च ।राज्यं वा त्रिषु लोकेषु नैतदर्हति भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२१ ।।
transliteration: hiraṇyaṁ vā suvarṇaṁ vā ratnāni vividhāni ca ।rājyaṁ vā triṣu lokeṣu naitadarhati bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.21 ।।

translations.english: Spoken in that way by Vaidehi, Hanuman stood with folded palms in front of Sita and replied in delight.
